title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Location
description: The location of a tourism entity (accommodation, historical/cultural resource, etc.), modeled as a standalone, referenceable resource, matching the source ontology's own design (estur:Location, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Location'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the WGS84 geographical position, derived from the source ontology's gsp:lat/gsp:long values.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

locality.description: Property. The locality/municipality (estur:locality). NOTE: one illustrative example in the source repository used a non-standard 'estur:city' term for this same concept; 'locality' is the property actually used in the real open-data examples and is kept here as the faithful mapping.
